summary: Maps a status result from the VFXGetTracking function-pointer global into one of several fixed integer codes: returns 4 when the routine is not installed, 0 for status 1, 7 for status 2 or 3, and 6 for any other status.

operations.description: If the VFXGetTracking function pointer is null, return 4 immediately.
Call VFXGetTracking(a1, a2, a3) through the global function pointer and store its result in v3.
Default path returns 6 for any other v3 value.

unresolved: Meaning of the input arguments a1, a2, a3 to VFXGetTracking.
Semantic meaning of the fixed result codes 4, 0, 7 and 6.
Purpose of the caller sub_4F8B00 for this status mapping.
